evidence_required: Four properties, each with one example.

marking.criterion: Property 1 with a concrete refused or handled example (for example default-deny allowlist refusing ethtool -s rail0 speed 200000)
Property 2 with a concrete example (for example argv without a shell, so an interface name cannot inject a command)
Property 3 with a concrete example (for example per-command timeouts for a hung lspci)
Property 4 with a concrete example (for example no sudo, record denied and fall back to journalctl -k; record every outcome; LC_ALL=C)

title: Safe collection
